# Interpretable logistic scorecard (the challenger)

*Generated by the Mkopo pipeline on 2026-08-02. Do not edit by hand.*

## Why this model exists

This is the benchmark the gradient booster has to beat. A champion that buys two points of Gini over a scorecard, at the cost of being unable to explain a decline, is not a good trade in a regulated lending book — so the trade has to be measured rather than assumed.

## Rank ordering out of time

Band 1 is the riskiest decile by score. The bad rate must fall monotonically; a scorecard that inverts anywhere in the middle is not usable as a decline strategy.
